description: Localization (i18n) resource file for the Select2 plugin, providing Khmer language translations for various UI messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when data loading fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user should delete characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user should input more characters when input is below minimum length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more data is being fetched.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message shown while a search is in progress.
